reference.source: dict.go, dict_test.go, and Sprig dict documentation
reference.behavior: Merge, overwrite, pick, and omit preserve nested object identity while deepCopy isolates it.

request.name: dict-aliasing
request.template: {{$s1 := dict "nested" (dict "x" 1)}}{{$m1 := merge (dict) $s1}}{{$i := set (get $s1 "nested") "x" 2}}{{get (get $m1 "nested") "x"}}/{{$s2 := dict "nested" (dict "x" 1)}}{{$m2 := mergeOverwrite (dict) $s2}}{{$i = set (get $s2 "nested") "x" 2}}{{get (get $m2 "nested") "x"}}/{{$s3 := dict "nested" (dict "x" 1)}}{{$p := pick $s3 "nested"}}{{$i = set (get $s3 "nested") "x" 2}}{{get (get $p "nested") "x"}}/{{$s4 := dict "nested" (dict "x" 1)}}{{$o := omit $s4 "other"}}{{$i = set (get $s4 "nested") "x" 2}}{{get (get $o "nested") "x"}}/{{$s5 := dict "nested" (dict "x" 1)}}{{$c := deepCopy $s5}}{{$i = set (get $s5 "nested") "x" 2}}{{get (get $c "nested") "x"}}
